tint: multiply ONLY neutral grey pixels (r == g == b): rgb * role / 255. Role parts (jackets, bodies, props) are grey 206/166/232; skin, hats, faces, every white (255,253,248) are coloured and drawn as is
scale: PNG is 2x the logical 440x480 canvas (880x960). In the 1080x1920 frame: scale 1.1 = character ~ 500 px tall (two on screen), 1.3 for a single hero; smooth scaling
files: <name>/<state>_<i>.png, all frames of one object share size, anchor and top
talk: every object has a 2-frame talk state (mouth flap, 8 fps): play it while that character speaks in captions
generic_states: catch (squash-stretch) and flinch (shake) exist for every object
